desc: The QR tactical green laser-flashlight set allows you to quickly switch back and forth from a Green. Laser to an LED flashlight by just changing the front assemblies. The tactical green laser-flashlight is an ultra bright green laser or a blinding 35 lumen LED flashlight in a compact sleek design. With a quick detachable Weaver style mount, you can quickly install and remove the powerful green laser or flashlight in seconds and mount it onto virtually any of your firearms without the use of tools. Precise windage and elevation adjustments on the green laser head, keep your shots on target. Constructed of solid anodized aluminum, this QR tactical green laser-flashlight set is tough as nails.
